'''Pawel''' was a tall [[Gender/Legends|male]] of unidentified [[Species/Legends|species]]. This person was seen in [[Depatar/Legends|Depatar]], the City of Masks, in [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]]. Like all the visitors and many inhabitants, this person was in disguise, particularly covered in shiny feathers with a great tail-fan. As his voice was higher than usual in a male, it was believed he used electronic modification for it.
